rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that has dropped under gravity.

example.english: The fallen cup is on the floor.
example.jyutping: dit3 lok6 zo2 ge3 bui1 hai2 dei6 haa6

rows.note: Use this when a building or other structure has collapsed, rather than merely fallen over.

example.english: The fallen house needs to be demolished and rebuilt.
example.jyutping: taap3 zo2 ge3 uk1 jiu3 caak3 zo2 cung4 gin3

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone killed while fighting in a war or battle.

example.english: The fallen soldiers will always deserve our respect.
example.traditional: 戰死咗嘅士兵永遠值得我哋尊敬。
example.jyutping: zin3 sei2 zo2 ge3 si6 bing1 wing5 jyun5 zik6 dak1 ngo5 dei6 zyun1 ging3

rows.note: Use this for the prestige or power slice of “fallen from grace,” not for a literal fall or death in battle.

example.english: The fallen politician is soon ignored by everyone.
example.traditional: 失勢嘅政客好快冇人理。
example.jyutping: sat1 sai3 ge3 zing3 haak3 hou2 faai3 mou5 jan4 lei5
